articles.summary: Sable Offshore Corp. (the “ Company ”) (NYSE: SOC) today announced that it plans to release its third quarter 2026 financial and operating results before the market opens on Monday, November 9, 2026. The Company will host a conference call and webcast to discuss the results on the same day at 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time (10:00 a.m. Central Time). Conference Call Information Interested parties may register for and access the live webcast at https://sable-offshore-corp-3q-2026-earnings-call-nov-2026.open-exchange.net/ or through the Company website at sableoffshore.com . A replay of the webcast will be available on Sable's website following the call. Harrison Breaud Vice President, Finance Investor Relations IR@sableoffshore.com (713) 579-8111 Source: Sable Offshore Corp.
articles.title: Sable Offshore Corp. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release Date and Conference Call
